answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The cipher of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, clawed back after a replayed submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A willow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ocean of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
